thread:
Jordan P: Quick sync: we need a compact benchmark narrative for the launch post + webinar. thinking the hook should be "cost-aware tail latency" — show why teams care beyond averages.
Tina S: Strong. call out three customer questions up front: Will my users feel the slowness? How much does that cost me? Can I control it?
Evan K: For visuals, propose a two-panel layout: left = empirical CDF (latency) comparing 3 serving configs; right = $/1k tokens bar with annotations for quantization & batching. keep labels non-technical.
Priya R: Add a tiny flow diagram below: request -> fastpath (low tail) vs fallback -> cheaper model (lower $). That explains routing without heavy text.
Jordan P: Copy angle: "Not all latency is visible in a mean. The tail drives experience and spend. Redwood shrinks the tail and lowers unit cost with smart routing and deploy-time profiles." Short and punchy.
Tina S: Examples help. Suggest one concrete customer vignette: "Startup A reduced 99.9th percentile from 900ms to 320ms and shaved 30% off token spend by combining prefix caching and quantized models"
Evan K: I'll anonymize and round numbers. from last run:
```
config, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, p999_ms, usd_per_1k
fastpath-q8, 55, 140, 260, 320, 0.28
fastpath-fp16, 50, 150, 300, 450, 0.42
slowpath-quant, 120, 300, 520, 900, 0.12
```
Priya R: Nice. For the launch post headline options: 1) "Predictable tails, predictable costs" 2) "Shrink latency surprises, cut unit spend" 3) "Benchmarks that map to real product SLAs" Which do we like?
Jordan P: Lean into #1 but variant: "Predictable tails, predictable costs — benchmarks for product teams."
Tina S: CTA: Webinar + short playbook download. Webinar tagline: "Benchmarks, routing patterns, and a live Q&A with infra". Put registration link in the post. MarketingBot: webinar page -> https://redwood.ai/webinar-benchplaybook :calendar:
Evan K: Visual notes for the designer: CDF x-axis log scale from 10ms->2000ms; mark p50/p95/p99 lines; color palette: teal (fastpath), amber (fp16), slate (slowpath). Right panel: simple bars with error bars for variability.
Priya R: Also include a footnote: "Benchmarks run on mixed production traffic slice, commit: a1b2c3d" so ops can repro. Evan, can you post the commit and dataset id after?
Evan K: will post SHA and data slice in follow-up.
Jordan P: Timeline: draft post + hero visual by EOD tomorrow, webinar page live by Monday, slide deck + playbook by webinar date. Any objections?
Tina S: none. I'll own the registration funnel and email copy.
Priya R: I'll write the 1-page playbook (Routing choices + quick configs) and hand it to design.
MarketingBot: registration-tracking created -> https://redwood.ai/track/webinar-benchplaybook (auto) :white_check_mark:
Evan K: uploading bench CSV + SHA in replies now.
